question: In January 2022 , which of the following states has decided to increase the age of retirement from 60 to 62 years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• In January 2022, the **Andhra Pradesh** government decided to increase the retirement age of state government employees from **60 to 62 years**.
 
• This was done through an ordinance promulgated by the Governor and took effect from January 1, 2022​
 
• This decision was made with an aim to **utilize the experience and expertise of senior employees** for a longer period.
 
• The decision is expected to benefit a large number of state government employees who were due for retirement.
 
• It reflects the government's commitment to improve the working conditions and benefits for its employees.
